question_record.context: A high-severity security incident occurred on 2024-07-04, involving ransomware payload being remotely launched on the device `vnevado-win11t`. This ransomware could potentially encrypt the content on the device, making it inaccessible to users. The attack was linked with an account named `dp5hn` with SID `S-1-5-21-1840191660-8534830288-125585561-1522` and associated IP `99.83.111.100`.
question_record.question: During the remote ransomware payload launch, a suspicious remote activity was observed. Can you provide the SID of the account associated with this suspicious remote activity?
solution: A ransomware payload was remotely launched on this device using the account `dp5hn`.

Suspicious remote activities, such as initiating interactive sessions, modifying files, passing WMI commands, or creating scheduled tasks were observed on this machine using the account with SID `S-0-6-5`.

143.name: Ransomware payload remotely launched.
143.description: A ransomware payload was remotely launched on this device. Attackers might be attempting to encrypt content on this device, rendering it unusable to users. For more information, read the Threat Analytics report, Threat overview: Human-operated ransomware: https://security.microsoft.com/threatanalytics3/05658b6c-dc62-496d-ad3c-c6a795a33c27/analystreport

107.name: Suspicious remote activity
107.description: Suspicious activity initiated remotely was observed on this machine. This alert can flag attempts to initiate interactive sessions, modify files, pass WMI commands, create scheduled tasks, and other potentially malicious activities from a remote machine.
